avis.texte: Ifw been using PC for years. The 2% product is a HG item for me and has been a staple in my routine for over 10yrs. I tried this product out for over a month and for me it is not a PC alternative. I used it starting 1x a week as stated on the bottle… as someone who uses products that can be more "harsh" on my skin, this did not vibe well with the rest of my products at all. Everytime I used this product my face wohld become extremely sensitive and my face would become red. I had to be very careful about which products I used in conjunction with it, and kept my skin care to a minimum during the use and for 2 days after. Between the redness and how dry this made my skin, I do not recommend this peoduct.
i really like this toner. glad that i can order from ulta now. i used to use pauls choice. but this is also a good one for the price

I am highly satisfied with this product. I noticed immediate improvements in my skin tone, texture, acne scars, and hormonal acne. Additionally, it reduced the appearance of my smile while maintaining my skin's hydration throughout the night.

I hope this product would be comparable to Paula's Choice 2% BHA exfoliating toner since it seems like they have similar ingredients. However, i did not notice any improvements in my oilness, skin tone evenness, or unclogged pores in the past ~3 months I've been using this. Disappointed that it didn't work for me. Ill be trying Paula's choice again once I finish this bottle of Anuva
